'''Yuprel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] in [[Mos Anek]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
